items.text: Honey never spoils; edible jars have been found in ancient Egyptian tombs.
A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
The Great Library of Alexandria was not a single building but a complex of research halls.
Bananas are berries; strawberries are not.
The shortest war in history, Britain vs Zanzibar in 1896, lasted about 38 minutes.
There are more trees on Earth than stars in the Milky Way.
Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
The Pacific Ocean is larger than all of Earth's land combined.
Sharks are older than trees; they predate forests by tens of millions of years.
The word "salary" comes from Latin salarium, linked to salt rations for Roman soldiers.
Antarctica is the world's largest desert by area.
Human bones are about five times stronger than steel of the same density.
The Eiffel Tower can be up to 15 cm taller in summer due to thermal expansion.
A bolt of lightning is about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.
Wombat droppings are cube-shaped.
The Sahara was once green savanna with lakes and human settlements.
Paper cuts hurt more because the edge is irregular and often hits many nerve endings.
The world's oldest known living tree is a bristlecone pine over 4,800 years old.
Sound travels about four times faster in water than in air.
The human nose can distinguish at least a trillion different scents.
Canada has more lakes than the rest of the world combined.
A jiffy is a real unit of time in physics — the time light takes to travel one fermi.
Butterflies taste with their feet.
The longest English word typed with one hand is "stewardesses".
Hot water can freeze faster than cold water under certain conditions (Mpemba effect).
The heart of a blue whale is roughly the size of a small car.
There is no land at the North Pole — only sea ice over the Arctic Ocean.
The invention of zero as a number is credited to mathematicians in ancient India.
Cats cannot taste sweetness; they lack the functional receptor.
Mount Everest grows a few millimeters each year as the Himalayas rise.
The Amazon River once flowed west before the Andes rose and reversed it.
Your stomach gets a new lining every few days to avoid digesting itself.
